LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Gravity.label: mythal rule: gravity
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Gravity.description: This floor's mythal drags everything down. Disappears after leaving the mythal dungeon.
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Fury.label: mythal rule: frenzy
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Fury.description: This floor's mythal stirs up every swing. Disappears after leaving the mythal dungeon.
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Lifeflow.label: mythal rule: life reflux
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Lifeflow.description: This floor's mythal pours life force back into every body, enemies included. Disappears after leaving the mythal dungeon.
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Stasis.label: mythal rule: time stasis
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Stasis.description: Time has almost stopped on this floor: wounds don't bleed, nobody gets hungry or tired. Disappears after leaving the mythal dungeon.
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Fragile.label: mythal rule: shattered
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Fragile.description: This floor's mythal makes flesh fragile. Disappears after leaving the mythal dungeon.
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Blessing.label: mythal rule: blessing
LanguageData.LP_MythalRule_Blessing.description: This floor's mythal recognizes you and secretly helps. Disappears after leaving the mythal dungeon.
